selection_policy.runtime_acceptance_scope: same use_case_id and organization/site context only
selection_policy.rule: Printer mapping behavior is organization/site-specific. Technical similarity is never authority to reuse another use case.

status_definitions.proven: Tracked product workflow exists and its assumptions/proof contract are explicitly registered for this organization/site context.
status_definitions.discovery_required: No mapping implementation is authorized yet. Observe and document the organization's actual standards before creating a product workflow.
status_definitions.unsupported: The context is known but SysAdminSuite intentionally has no supported mapping implementation.
status_definitions.deprecated: Historical use case retained for traceability; it must not be selected for new work.

proof.registration: SYSTEM identity plus requested queue in HKLM per-computer printer-connection evidence
proof.runtime_acceptance: real requested document observed printing after this use case's canonical workflow

discovery_requirements: approved target naming and administrator authority
mapping scope: per-user, per-computer, or another organization-defined model
approved Windows mapping mechanism and elevation identity
site-specific exceptions for newly acquired or independently operated hospitals
